select c.camera_id, c.tree_id, c.category_node_id, n.node_name as category_node_name, c.camera_code, c.camera_name, c.sn, c.view_angle, c.manufacturer, c.model_name, c.status, c.create_time, c.remark, case when b.bind_id is null then false else true end as bound, b.vehicle_id as bound_vehicle_id, v.plate_no as bound_plate_no from biz_camera c left join biz_tree_node n on n.node_id = c.category_node_id and n.del_flag = '0' left join biz_vehicle_equipment_bind b on b.equipment_type = '1' and b.equipment_id = c.camera_id and b.del_flag = '0' left join biz_vehicle v on v.id = b.vehicle_id and v.del_flag = 0
c.del_flag = '0' and c.status = '0' and (b.bind_id is null or b.vehicle_id = #{vehicleId})
and ( c.camera_code like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or c.camera_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or c.sn like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
order by c.camera_code asc, c.camera_id desc
